content:
1. **Keep a consistent sleep schedule.** Go to bed and wake up at the same times every day, even on weekends. This trains your body's internal clock to expect sleep at the right time.

2. **Get morning sunlight.** Ten to thirty minutes of outdoor light within an hour of waking helps anchor your circadian rhythm and makes it easier to feel sleepy at night.
